inputs.prompt: What is the latest K-401-PT-3 pressure in psi? Return one JSON object with keys value (number), unit (string), explanation (string), evidence (array of IDs). No report or work order.

outputs.explanation: PT-3 is stored in bar and must be converted using 1 bar = 14.5037738 psi.

metadata.reference_sql: SELECT value * 14.5037738 FROM sensor_readings WHERE tag_id='K-401-PT-3' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

inputs.prompt: What is the mean over all 45 days K-401-PT-3 pressure in psi? Return one JSON object with keys value (number), unit (string), explanation (string), evidence (array of IDs). No report or work order.

outputs.explanation: PT-3 is stored in bar and must be converted using 1 bar = 14.5037738 psi.

metadata.reference_sql: SELECT avg(value) * 14.5037738 FROM sensor_readings WHERE tag_id='K-401-PT-3'

inputs.prompt: What is the maximum over all 45 days K-401-PT-3 pressure in psi? Return one JSON object with keys value (number), unit (string), explanation (string), evidence (array of IDs). No report or work order.

outputs.explanation: PT-3 is stored in bar and must be converted using 1 bar = 14.5037738 psi.

inputs.prompt: What is the minimum over all 45 days K-401-PT-3 pressure in psi? Return one JSON object with keys value (number), unit (string), explanation (string), evidence (array of IDs). No report or work order.

outputs.explanation: PT-3 is stored in bar and must be converted using 1 bar = 14.5037738 psi.

metadata.reference_sql: SELECT min(value) * 14.5037738 FROM sensor_readings WHERE tag_id='K-401-PT-3'

inputs.prompt: What is the mean pressure across all three K-401 pressure tags over 45 days, in psi? Return one JSON object with keys value (number), unit (string), explanation (string), evidence (array of IDs). No report or work order.

outputs.explanation: Normalize each tag before averaging; one tag is bar and the other two are psi.

metadata.reference_sql: SELECT avg(r.value * CASE WHEN t.unit_of_measure='bar' THEN 14.5037738 ELSE 1 END) FROM sensor_readings r JOIN sensor_tags t USING(tag_id) WHERE t.asset_id='K-401'

inputs.prompt: How much greater is the latest K-401-PT-3 pressure than the latest K-401-PT-1 pressure, in psi? Return one JSON object with keys value (number), unit (string), explanation (string), evidence (array of IDs). No report or work order.

outputs.explanation: PT-3 must be converted from bar before subtracting PT-1 in psi.

metadata.reference_sql: SELECT (SELECT value*14.5037738 FROM sensor_readings WHERE tag_id='K-401-PT-3' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) - (SELECT value FROM sensor_readings WHERE tag_id='K-401-PT-1' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
